requirement: Reduce the connected inputs or forward the default
rationale: Two UInt sources exclude a distinct nonzero default from their reduction. A separate graph with no source transforms the default and never calls inputFn.

requirement: Generate exactly one value per connected output with the supplied output function
rationale: The directed harness connects two sinks and requires distinct transformed values 0x53 and 0x54.

requirement: Drive each diplomatic output edge with the corresponding generated value
rationale: The two sink IOs expose the values delivered through separate output edges.

requirement: Allow no output when the fixed node permits it

rationale: The input function selects the first input unchanged, so both connected input types must be checked even when the resulting value matches the sink.

requirement: Reject incompatible result types and an invalid output count
rationale: One graph generates a wrong-width result and another generates too many values. Each must be rejected during elaboration.
